description: Requisitos organizacionais derivados de policies/. GERADO por `python -m governance export`. Edite policies/*.yaml.

securityRequirements.name: arch-hex-001
securityRequirements.description: Domínio livre de frameworks (Spring, JPA). Classes em `domain` não podem depender de Spring (`org.springframework`) nem de Jakarta/Javax Persistence. A regra do motor cobre import, import static e nome totalmente qualificado (inclusive em anotações). Ofuscação via escapes Unicode é coberta por SEC-OBFUSC-001, e o ArchUnit do build verifica o bytecode.
securityRequirements.applicability: Classes e interfaces Java de produção em pacotes de domínio (**/src/main/java/**/domain/**/*.java).
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if the domain class depends only on Java SE and domain types. NON_COMPLIANT if the domain class references org.springframework.*, jakarta.persistence.* or javax.persistence.* (import, static import or fully qualified name).
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Remova anotações Spring/JPA do domínio. Mova o mapeamento ORM para `infrastructure/persistence` (ex.: ClienteEntity) e converta com mappers.

securityRequirements.name: lgpd-log-001
securityRequirements.description: Dado pessoal em logs, traces, métricas ou exceções. Nenhum dado pessoal (CPF, CNPJ, RG, e-mail, telefone, cartão, senha) pode chegar a logs, traces, métricas ou mensagens de exceção sem mascaramento. A regra do motor cobre o caso direto em uma linha (identificador pessoal como argumento de log fora de mask/sanitize/redact). Os casos indiretos (toString() de objeto com dado pessoal, corpo de request, atributo de span, tag de métrica, chamada de log quebrada em várias linhas) ficam com o LLM, em modo consultivo até o eval justificar bloqueio.
securityRequirements.applicability: Código Java/Kotlin de produção que escreve logs, spans, métricas ou exceções.
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if personal data is masked (PIISanitizer.mask) or replaced by technical identifiers before reaching logs, traces, metrics or exception messages. NON_COMPLIANT if CPF, CNPJ, RG, e-mail, phone, card or password values reach logs, traces, metric tags or exception messages unmasked.
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Passe o valor por `PIISanitizer.mask(valor)` antes de logar, ou registre só um identificador técnico (id do pedido, hash). Nunca logue o objeto inteiro nem o corpo de request/response.

securityRequirements.name: owasp-a01
securityRequirements.description: Controle de acesso: menor privilégio, default deny, IDOR e SSRF. Enforce least privilege, default deny, and IDOR/SSRF prevention across APIs and microservices (OWASP A01:2025).
securityRequirements.applicability: Applies to all REST/GraphQL APIs, Lambda functions, API Gateways, and S3 bucket access policies.
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if APIs use explicit authorization checks, IAM roles with least privilege, default-deny access controls, and sanitized URLs. NON_COMPLIANT if object IDs are accepted from user input without ownership validation (IDOR) or unvalidated external HTTP requests are issued (SSRF).
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Implement Amazon Verified Permissions or Cedar policies for fine-grained authorization. Validate user ownership before object access (CWE-639) and restrict outbound VPC traffic for SSRF prevention (CWE-918).

securityRequirements.name: owasp-a02
securityRequirements.description: Configuração segura: defaults seguros, sem debug, sem acesso público. Ensure secure defaults, disable active debug code, and restrict public access (OWASP A02:2025).
securityRequirements.applicability: Applies to Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation/Terraform), application configuration files, and S3 bucket settings.
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if S3 Block Public Access is active, debug endpoints are disabled in production binaries, and security headers are enforced. NON_COMPLIANT if debug binaries or unencrypted transmission exist.
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Remove active debug code (CWE-489) before deployment. Use AWS Config rules to enforce S3 Block Public Access and TLS 1.2+.

securityRequirements.name: owasp-a03
securityRequirements.description: Cadeia de suprimentos: dependências mantidas e SBOM. Validate third-party dependencies and maintain Software Bill of Materials (OWASP A03:2025).
securityRequirements.applicability: Applies to package manifests (package.json, pom.xml, requirements.txt) and container build pipelines.
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if all third-party libraries are up to date without critical CVEs and scanned via Amazon Inspector or CodeArtifact. NON_COMPLIANT if unmaintained or obsolete components (CWE-1104, CWE-1395) are included.
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Set up automated dependency scanning using Amazon Inspector / OWASP Dependency-Track and restrict packages to internal Amazon CodeArtifact repositories.

securityRequirements.name: owasp-a04
securityRequirements.description: Criptografia: KMS CMK em repouso e TLS 1.2+ em trânsito. Enforce strong cryptography and Customer Managed Keys (CMK) for data at rest and in transit (OWASP A04:2025).
securityRequirements.applicability: Applies to S3 buckets, DynamoDB, RDS, CloudWatch Logs, and API communications.
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if data at rest is encrypted with AWS KMS CMK and data in transit uses TLS 1.2+. NON_COMPLIANT if hardcoded cryptographic keys (CWE-321) or cleartext transmission (CWE-319) are detected.
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Migrate secrets and keys to AWS Secrets Manager or KMS. Replace cleartext HTTP/FTP endpoints with HTTPS/TLS.

securityRequirements.name: owasp-a10
securityRequirements.description: Tratamento de exceções: fail-closed, sem stack trace ao cliente. Prevent improper error handling and ensure fail-closed logic (OWASP A10:2025).
securityRequirements.applicability: Applies to all application code, try-catch blocks, and API exception handlers.
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if exceptions are caught, logged securely without sensitive data, and fail securely (fail-closed). NON_COMPLIANT if stack traces or server internal information are returned to the client (CWE-550) or if system fails open (CWE-636).
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Implement global exception handlers that return generic error pages/JSON to clients while logging full details internally to CloudWatch.

securityRequirements.name: sec-secret-001
securityRequirements.description: Segredo ou credencial no código ou em configuração versionada. Chaves de API, tokens, senhas e chaves privadas não podem ser versionados (Secret Zero). O motor detecta formatos conhecidos (AWS, Google, GitHub, Slack, chave privada PEM) e atribuições literais a nomes como password/secret/token/api_key. O pipeline também roda o gitleaks sobre os commits do PR.
securityRequirements.applicability: Todo arquivo versionado (código, configuração, IaC, scripts).
securityRequirements.complianceCriteria: COMPLIANT if credentials are read from a secrets manager or injected environment variables. NON_COMPLIANT if API keys, tokens, passwords or private keys appear as literals in versioned files (CWE-798, CWE-321).
securityRequirements.remediationGuidance: Remova o valor, revogue a credencial (ela já está no histórico) e leia de um cofre (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault) ou de variável de ambiente injetada no deploy.
